subject: AcmeCorp POC: Rebaseline scope & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCorp POC: Recap + proposed next steps

Hi Alice — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed plan so we’re aligned going into the POC: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary goals: reduce customer support triage time (automated routing + summarization) and improve search relevance for internal KB.
- Expected traffic profile: ~500 qps peak across three regions, median request size ~120 tokens.

Proposed POC scope (initial):
1) Inference for classification + reranking for KB search (evaluate relevance lift)
2) Email summarization prototype for a subset of support queue (evaluate summary quality and time-to-first-byte)

Success criteria (proposal):
- Search rerank: +15% CTR on top-3 results vs baseline (measured on sample corpus)
- Summarization quality: human-rated >= 4/5 on a 100-sample eval set
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 300 ms, sustain 50 concurrent requests

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Tech kickoff: Oct 18 (1 hour) to align on data delivery and infra
- Integration window: Oct 19–Oct 25 (data ingestion + connector setup)
- Evaluation window: Oct 26–Nov 8 (2 weeks of live / shadow testing)
- Wrap + decisions: Nov 9–11

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (commercial lead), Jonas (solutions engineer), Dylan (SRE support)
- Acme: Alice (product), Bob Li (eng lead)

Attachments: ACME_POC_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan + eval checklist)

Next steps: can you confirm the kickoff on Oct 18 morning PT and share a sample of the support queue (anonymized) and a HubSpot/GDrive link for schema?
\Cheers,\nMarissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acmecorp.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acmecorp.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCorp POC: Recap + proposed next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the thorough recap. Agree with most of this and we’re excited to move forward. A couple of asks/clarifications from our side:

1) Add one more prioritized use case: enterprise email summarization (deliver concise summaries for account teams). This is slightly different from support queue summaries and is a priority for our sales org.
2) Can we tighten the latency target to 250ms p95 if possible? Our sales workflows are sensitive to perceived latency.
3) We will need a connector to pull email data from our internal system (we have an S3 staging bucket and a small ETL pipeline). Can Redwood support a simple S3 ingestion + metadata mapping?

Stakeholders to include: Bob Li (eng), Sarah Kim (sales ops). If we add the email summarization use case, what impact does that have on scope/timeline/cost?
\Tentatively OK to keep kickoff Oct 18 AM PT — I’ll confirm by EOD and share the sample data link.
\Best,
Alice
Alice Tan
Director, Product 
AcmeCorp
alice.tan@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: AcmeCorp POC: Recap + proposed next steps — rebaseline options

Hi Alice — thanks for the notes and the ask to include email summarization for the sales org. We can support that but it does change the POC scope slightly. Options below so you can choose what works best for Acme: 

Option A (recommended): Add email summarization as a parallel experiment (stretch goal) — keep original 2-week evaluation window but include an A/B sample (we’ll evaluate qualitatively). Minimal infra changes; no change to cost or timeline.

Option B (rebaseline core POC): Make email summarization a first-class POC objective. Impacts:
- Additional integration: S3 ingestion mapping + metadata (we estimate 1–2 engineering days from Redwood/Solutions to template mapping)
- Extend evaluation window by 1 week (new evaluation window Oct 26–Nov 15) to collect sufficient sales workflow samples
- Updated success criteria: summarization: human-rated >= 4/5 on 200-sample eval set; p95 latency target 250 ms for summarization flows
- Minor pricing delta for extended runtime and extra infra during evaluation (I can share numbers once you confirm)

Next steps I propose: 
- Confirm which option you prefer by EOD Fri Oct 15
- If Option B: we’ll provide a rebaseline doc + updated eval checklist and schedule a 30-min tech sync on Oct 18 (after kickoff) to go over ingestion details
\I’ve attached an updated plan that marks the differences (ACME_POC_rebaseline_v2.pdf).
\If it helps, Jonas can outline the connector approach and the estimated effort in a separate note (cc’d).
\Thanks — happy to be flexible.
\Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
\Attachment stub: ACME_POC_rebaseline_v2.pdf (2 pages — changes highlighted)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeCorp POC: Recap + proposed next steps — connector + timeline

Marissa / team — quick technical note on the S3 ingestion and timeline if Acme chooses Option B: 

- Connector approach: we can support S3 ingestion + small mapping layer. We’ll provide a mapping template for: subject, body, timestamp, thread_id, customer_id. Sample ingest pipeline requires a service account with read-only S3 credentials (or a pre-signed URL workflow).
- Estimated effort: 1–2 Redwood SE days for mapping + validation; 1 Redwood SRE day for infra setup (staging bucket + access).
- Data needs: 2–3k anonymized emails for initial eval; include canonical case labels if available.
- Timeline impact: add 5 business days to integrate and validate; new proposed kickoff/integration window if Option B is chosen:
  - Tech sync: Oct 18 (30 min)
  - Integration: Oct 19–Oct 25
  - Extended evaluation: Oct 26–Nov 15
\Action items:
- Acme: share S3 staging location + sample files (Alice / Bob)
- Redwood: I’ll prepare the mapping template and pre-flight checklist by EOD Oct 15
